text:
Sam: Lark (prospect) returned with perf reqs. They want a POC: mixed traffic (gen 60% / embed 40%), target sustained 140 rps, p95 < 300ms, p99 < 600ms. Also asked for cost ballpark for ~50M tokens/mo and confirmation on CMK/KMS. Can we run on Dedicated for Wed?

Lee: Yep. I can book infra. @Priya can you take security blurb for CMK and SOC2?

Priya: Confirmed: Dedicated supports customer-managed keys; Private supports HSM-backed keys. SOC2 Type II evidence available via secure share. I'll prepare a short appendix.

Lee: Plan proposal: warmup 10m (short prefixes) -> stepped ramp 40->80->120->140 (10m each) -> soak 20m. Capture p50/p95/p99, tokens, error rates, prometheus snapshots, and GPU telemetry. Abort criteria: p99 > 900ms or error rate > 2% or GPU mem > 90%.

Sam: For pricing, they want a quick ballpark. Can you draft scenarios: hosted, dedicated-2gpu, dedicated-3gpu with utilization assumptions?

Lee: Will do. Quick back-of-envelope: hosted ~ $0.0007/token (~$35k/mo), dedicated 2-GPU amortized ~$18k-24k/mo at 60-80% util, 3-GPU ~$26k-34k. I'll put exact assumptions in runbook.

bench-bot: Allocation: dedicated-small (2x GPU) reserved 2026-04-08T09:00 UTC id alloc-9b3c.

Priya: Also note for security Q: audit logs retention configurable, we can provide attestation for key separation and rotation policies.

Sam: Load repro snippet for bench team (wrk2 wrapper):
```bash
# warmup
./scripts/run_load.sh --rate 10 --dur 10m --payload short_prefix.json
# ramp
for r in 40 80 120 140; do
  ./scripts/run_rate.sh --rate $r --dur 10m --payload mix_payload.json > run_${r}.log
done
# soak
./scripts/run_rate.sh --rate 140 --dur 20m --payload mix_payload.json > soak.log
```
Include embed every 5th request to match 60/40 mix.

Lee: After run we'll upload run_40.log,...,run_140.log, soak.log, prom-snapshot.json, GPU telemetry and a one-paragraph exec summary with recommended next steps (increase slice or quantize) and cost table.

Sam: Demo scheduled Friday; need green. If tail is bad, plan to present fallback: smaller model or routing to lower-latency variant and cost tradeoff.

Priya: I'll attach the compliance appendix and CMK note to the customer packet after the run.

Sam: Thanks team. Ping when run starts. :thumbsup:
